basic_details.job_title: IISER Berhampur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: IISER Berhampur Recruitment 2026 has 1 temporary Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) post. The post is on the project "Nonlocal singular problems in the Heisenberg group", which is funded by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). The Principal Investigator (PI) is in the Dept. of Mathematical Sciences. The engagement is for one year, and the pay is ₹ 37000/- per month + HRA as applicable (as per ANRF norms). Candidates need an M.Sc degree in Mathematics and must have qualified GATE or CSIR-UGC NET. Applications go by email to the PI at [email protected], and the last date is 05:00 PM

important_dates.evaluation cum skill test: To be informed later to shortlisted candidates through Email

how_to_apply: Fill in the biodata form in the prescribed format that comes with the advertisement.
Add a brief mention of your research expertise.
Combine the biodata form and all supporting documents into a single PDF file of less than 10 MB.

Email the PDF to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] with the subject line: "Application for the Position of Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) against advt. no. IISERBPR/MTH/ANRF/120625/TSHyb/084/JRF dated 26-10-2026".
Send the email before 05:00 PM on 10 November 2026.
Biodata form in the prescribed format
A brief mention of your research expertise
For any information, the notice asks candidates to contact the PI, Dr. Prashanta Garain (Associate Professor, Dept. of Mathematical Sciences, IISER Berhampur), by email at [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives the qualification for the Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) "as per guidelines": Candidates should have an M.Sc degree in Mathematics. Candidates should have qualified GATE or CSIR-UGC NET. The notice also lists this job requirement: basic knowledge of Partial Differential Equations. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration per month: ₹ 37000/- + HRA as applicable (as per ANRF norms). Type of engagement: Temporary. Period of engagement: One year from the date of joining, subject to the availability and release of funds under the project. Extension: The engagement may be extended, subject to the incumbent's progress and performance and to the availability and release of project funds. Project references: Funding Agency File no. ANRF/ECRG/2024/000780/PMS; IISER BPR Project no. IISERBPR/MTH/ANRF/120625/TSHyb/084.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Berhampur Junior Research Fellowship (JRF)
content_sections.text: Biodata form in the prescribed format All supporting documents A brief mention of your research expertise For any information, the notice asks candidates to contact the PI, Dr. Prashanta Garain (Associate Professor, Dept. of Mathematical Sciences, IISER Berhampur), by email at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through an evaluation cum skill test. Only shortlisted candidates take this test. The date and mode of the test will be sent to them later by email. The notice does not say how candidates will be shortlisted.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IISER Berhampur Recruitment 2026 for JRF?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) post, on the ANRF-funded project "Nonlocal singular problems in the Heisenberg group".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IISER Berhampur JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date is 05:00 PM, Monday, 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IISER Berhampur JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have an M.Sc degree in Mathematics and should have qualified GATE or CSIR-UGC NET. The notice also asks for basic knowledge of Partial Differential Equations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IISER Berhampur JRF?
faq.answer: The remuneration is ₹ 37000/- per month + HRA as applicable (as per ANRF norms).

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the IISER Berhampur JRF fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is paid as applicable, as per ANRF norms, on top of ₹ 37000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IISER Berhampur JRF post?
faq.answer: Email the biodata form in the prescribed format, all supporting documents and a brief mention of your research expertise to [email protected]. Send everything as a single PDF of less than 10 MB.

faq.question: Q7. What subject line should the IISER Berhampur JRF application email have?
faq.answer: The subject line must be "Application for the Position of Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) against advt. no. IISERBPR/MTH/ANRF/120625/TSHyb/084/JRF dated 26-10-2026".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IISER Berhampur JRF?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates take an evaluation cum skill test. Its date and mode will be sent to them later by email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IISER Berhampur JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is temporary, for one year from the date of joining, subject to the availability and release of project funds. It may be extended based on the incumbent's progress and performance and the availability and release of project funds.
